pattern: SELECT .* FROM matches m1 WHERE year = [0-9]{4} AND m1\.winner\_id IN \(\ SELECT winner\_id FROM matches m2 WHERE year = [0-9]{4} \)
correction: Use the INTERSECT operator to find common winners between the two specified years.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that incorrectly use a subquery to compare data from different years, and suggests using the INTERSECT operator instead.
